description: Machine-readable OpenStudio -> SAM reverse-import coverage manifest. One entry per OpenStudio concept the importer meets. Statuses: Native (direct SAM mapping), Derived (deterministically calculated from OpenStudio data), Approximated (documented engineering assumption; a structured diagnostic is emitted), Unsupported (no safe SAM equivalent; a structured diagnostic is emitted when the source object is present), Deferred (detailed-HVAC programme), NotApplicable (no import semantics). docs/SAM_OPENSTUDIO_TO_SAM_COVERAGE.md is generated from this file and must not be parsed by tests. Every 'diagnostic' value must be a constant of SAM.Core.OpenStudio.OpenStudioImportDiagnosticCodes, enforced by reflection in ReverseCoverageTests.
deferredDomains: AirLoopHVAC and PlantLoop translation into SAM Systems

entries.notes: The stamped SAM.Name feature takes precedence over the sanitised OpenStudio object name.

entries.formula: radians = degrees * pi / 180 (exact inverse of the forward conversion)

entries.notes: No Location is created when latitude, longitude and elevation are all exactly zero - the OpenStudio default means the site was never set.
SAM Location carries no terrain class.
SAM Location carries no time zone.

When the referenced EPW is found on disk its hourly weather is loaded into SAM WeatherData and embedded (the slot the forward exporter reads back). When the file is absent, or ImportWeatherData is off, only the path is recorded - a reference is never presented as embedded weather.
Imported by name, date and heating/cooling role only: an EnergyPlus design day is parametric while a SAM DesignDay is an hourly weather day.
SAM AnalyticalModel carries no run period; it is set by the forward conversion options.
Calendar configuration of the run, not of the building.
Always 1:1; never collapsed by ThermalZone.
buildingTransformation applied to every surface vertex; SAM-authored OSMs have identity here.

Validated for vertex count, planarity, duplicates, self-intersection and minimum area; never repaired.
Duplicate and collinear vertices are removed while normalising a boundary. Shape, area and normal are unchanged, so this is reported at Information severity and kept distinct from invalid geometry.
Derived by EnergyPlus from the boundary condition; SAM re-derives it on export.

Validated by Panel.AddAperture; a subsurface outside its host is reported, not attached.

SAM shade panels are free-standing; the association is metadata only.

Materials and profiles the imported topology does not reference are removed.

entries.formula: areaPerPerson = 1 / peopleperSpaceFloorArea; sensible = activityLevel * sensibleHeatFraction; latent = activityLevel * (1 - sensibleHeatFraction)

entries.notes: No fixed split exists; the whole metabolic rate is imported as sensible.
An absolute count cannot become a density on a shared space type without inventing an area.

entries.notes: One deduplicated internal condition per space type.

A workflow of model measures with no simulation step produces a model but no EnergyPlus results. An import needs the model, not the results, so the simulation runner's failure verdict is downgraded to information and never invalidates the imported model.
